description: This file defines the ByAndFinder class, which extends ListFinder, and is used to construct entity conditions based on a logical AND of multiple field constraints, leveraging XML element input to initialize its internal field map.

classes.name: ByAndFinder
classes.description: A specialized ListFinder that constructs an EntityCondition representing a logical AND of multiple fields, based on an XML element input.

methods.name: ByAndFinder
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the ByAndFinder with an XML Element, setting up the internal field map.

methods.name: getWhereEntityCondition
methods.description: Creates and returns an EntityCondition based on the expanded and type-converted field map.
